title: Additional Autoimmune Diseases With Type 1 Diabetes in Pediatrics at Diabetes Diagnosis and During Follow-up
brief_summary: This study aims to describe the prevalence of additional autoimmune diseases and their specific antibodies at type 1 diabetes (T1D) diagnosis, and their incidence rate during follow-up, for children and adolescents. It also aims to describe the characteristics of the pediatric cohort followed since 2014 for type 1 diabetes by one of France's centers of reference for paediatric diabetes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with type 1 diabetes diagnosed with the following criteria: (i) Classic symptoms of diabetes or hyperglycemic crisis, with plasma glucose concentration ≥11.1 mmol/L (200 mg/dl), or (ii) fasting plasma glucose ≥7.0 mmol/l (≥126 mg/dl) ; and (iii) presence of diabetes associated autoantibodies : ICA, GAD, IA2, IAA and/or ZnT8
* age \< 18 years old at type 1 diabetes diagnostic
* type 1 diabetes diagnosed between 2014-01-01 and 2021-02-01

Exclusion Criteria:

* type 1 diabetes diagnostic not certain
study_population: Every patient followed for type 1 diabetes at the Children's Hospital of Nancy, France, between 2014-01-01 and 2021-02-01.
